prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
How to decide:
1. Find the model number (letters and digits, e.g. PSLX350H or MDR-J10) in the price-list item.
2. A candidate with the same model number is the same product, ignoring case, dashes and spaces,
   and ignoring a colour or variant suffix such as /BLUE or BK/WH on an otherwise identical base
   model. Different wording, descriptions or prices do not matter.
3. If no candidate shares the model number, pick one only when brand and product type are the
   same and the names share distinctive words. Otherwise answer "none".
4. Never answer "none" only because the wording or the price differs.
Confidence: 0.9 or more when the model number matches; 0.6 to 0.8 when brand and product type
match but no model number can be compared; below 0.5 when you are unsure.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else. Write "reason" first: one sentence that
compares the model numbers of the item and the best candidate. Then decide.
{"reason": "<comparison>", "choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>}

Price-list item:
name: Sharp AQUOS 52' D85U Series Black LCD Flat Panel HDTV - LC52D85U; brand: sharp; description: Sharp AQUOS 52' D85U Series Black LCD Flat Panel HDTV - LC52D85U/ Full HD 1080p (1920 x 1080) Resolution/ 10-Bit Advanced Super View/ 120Hz Fine Motion Enhanced/ Built-In ATSC/QAM/NTSC Tuners/ 60,000 Hours Lamp Life/ 10,000:1 Dynamic Contrast Ratio/ 4ms Response Time/ 3-Wavelength Back-Light System/...

Candidates:
1. name: Sharp AQUOS LC-52SE94U 52' LCD TV; brand: Sharp; description: 52' - Active Matrix TFT - ATSC, NTSC - 16:9 - 1920 x 1080 - HDTV; price: $2,049.99; check: model numbers differ, brand equal
2. name: Sharp AQUOS LC37D44U 37' LCD TV - LC37D44U; brand: Sharp; description: Sharp AQUOS LC-37D44U - 37' Widescreen LCD HDTV - 7500:1 Dynamic Contrast Ratio - 6ms Response Time; check: model numbers differ, brand equal
3. name: Sharp AQUOS LC-42D85U 42' LCD TV; brand: Sharp; description: 42' - Active Matrix TFT - ATSC, NTSC - 16:9 - 1920 x 1080 - HDTV - 1080p; price: $1,076.65; check: model numbers differ, brand equal

response.text: {"reason": "The model number LC52D85U in the price-list item does not match any candidate's model number exactly.", "choice": "none", "confidence": 0.9}
